visualCharacteristics.purpose: one view of the Lufthansa Group for Business member area, its data from lh-backends on the site's own host
traits: dashboard: greeting, dark blue tiles per page the roles open, the accounts
fund, profile, reports: a definition list of facts
history, users, reports' top routes: a table that scrolls on a phone
loading, empty, forbidden and error states as one paragraph

contentPattern.structure: 2 columns, label | value; every row optional. The variant names the view (dashboard, fund, history, users, reports, profile, accounts). Rows override the built-in English and German texts; Fund tile / History tile / Reports tile / Users tile | link set the dashboard tiles; Type-<code> / Status-<code> | text name the history's codes; Login page | link.

usage: lh-b2b /<root>/home (dashboard), fund, history, usermanagement (users), reports, profile, lhghome (accounts).
reuseGuidance: One block per member page. The roles per view are ROLE in b2b-member.js (as lh-backends checks them); each view is a branch of render().
